label: Praxis am Kastanienhof, Erlenbrück
html:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Atkinson+Hyperlegible+Next:wght@400;500;700&family=Source+Serif+4:ital,opsz,wght@0,8..60,500;0,8..60,600;1,8..60,500&display=swap');
  /* Praxis am Kastanienhof: two family doctors and their team in a small German town. Calm and legible: one 76rem
     grid of bands, the state of today first, then what the practice does, who works there, when it is open and the
     two forms patients use most. Looks: Clinic (white, a cool teal), Warm (cream, sage, serif headings) and High
     contrast (black on white, larger type, strong rules, nothing at a slant). */
  #in-practice {
    --background: oklch(0.99 0.003 200);
    --foreground: oklch(0.23 0.03 230);
    --card: oklch(1 0 0);
    --card-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --popover: oklch(1 0 0);
    --popover-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --muted: oklch(0.96 0.01 210);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.45 0.03 225);
    --border: oklch(0.9 0.012 215);
    --input: oklch(0.83 0.02 215);
    --primary: oklch(0.47 0.09 215);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.99 0.003 200);
    --secondary: oklch(0.95 0.015 210);
    --secondary-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --accent: oklch(0.94 0.018 210);
    --accent-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --destructive: oklch(0.52 0.19 27);
    --ring: oklch(0.55 0.11 215);
    --radius: 0.5rem;
    --radius-sm: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 4px));
    --radius-md: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 2px));
    --radius-lg: var(--radius);
    --radius-xl: calc(var(--radius) + 4px);
    --dr-band: oklch(0.965 0.01 210);
    --dr-open: oklch(0.5 0.13 155);
    --dr-closed: oklch(0.52 0.17 30);
    --dr-note: oklch(0.96 0.07 98);
    --dr-note-ink: oklch(0.25 0.03 80);
    --dr-pin: oklch(0.55 0.16 25);
    --dr-heading: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', var(--font-sans);
    --dr-gutter: max(clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem), calc((100% - 76rem) / 2));
    color-scheme: light;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    container: pr / inline-size;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
    overflow-x: clip;
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', var(--font-sans);
    font-size: 1.0625rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  #in-practice[data-look='warm'] {
    --background: oklch(0.975 0.012 85);
    --foreground: oklch(0.26 0.025 60);
    --card: oklch(0.99 0.008 85);
    --popover: oklch(0.99 0.008 85);
    --muted: oklch(0.945 0.018 85);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.46 0.03 65);
    --border: oklch(0.89 0.02 80);
    --input: oklch(0.8 0.025 75);
    --primary: oklch(0.45 0.07 150);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.99 0.008 85);
    --secondary: oklch(0.94 0.02 90);
    --accent: oklch(0.935 0.025 120);
    --ring: oklch(0.52 0.08 150);
    --radius: 1rem;
    --dr-band: oklch(0.95 0.02 88);
    --dr-open: oklch(0.47 0.1 150);
    --dr-closed: oklch(0.5 0.14 40);
    --dr-note: oklch(0.86 0.06 70);
    --dr-note-ink: oklch(0.24 0.03 60);
    --dr-pin: oklch(0.9 0.03 90 / 0.8);
    --dr-heading: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif;
  }
  #in-practice[data-look='contrast'] {
    --background: oklch(1 0 0);
    --foreground: oklch(0.1 0 0);
    --card: oklch(1 0 0);
    --popover: oklch(1 0 0);
    --muted: oklch(0.95 0 0);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.28 0 0);
    --border: oklch(0.1 0 0);
    --input: oklch(0.1 0 0);
    --primary: oklch(0.33 0.16 265);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(1 0 0);
    --secondary: oklch(0.93 0 0);
    --accent: oklch(0.92 0.03 265);
    --destructive: oklch(0.45 0.19 27);
    --ring: oklch(0.33 0.16 265);
    --radius: 0.25rem;
    --dr-band: oklch(0.96 0 0);
    --dr-open: oklch(0.38 0.11 150);
    --dr-closed: oklch(0.42 0.17 28);
    --dr-note: oklch(1 0 0);
    --dr-note-ink: oklch(0.1 0 0);
    --dr-pin: oklch(0.1 0 0);
    zoom: 1.15;
  }
  #in-practice [hidden] {
    display: none !important;
  }
  #in-practice :is(h1, h2, h3, .dialog-title, .card-title, .mk-section-header-title, .mk-team-member-name) {
    font-family: var(--dr-heading);
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }
  #in-practice p {
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }
  /* layers of one look */
  #in-practice [data-for] {
    display: none;
  }
  #in-practice[data-look='clinic'] [data-for~='clinic'],
  #in-practice[data-look='warm'] [data-for~='warm'],
  #in-practice[data-look='contrast'] [data-for~='contrast'] {
    display: block;
  }
  /* the bands: one 76rem grid, alternating grounds */
  #in-practice > :is(section, footer) {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    padding: clamp(3.5rem, 7vw, 5.5rem) var(--dr-gutter);
    scroll-margin-top: 4.5rem;
  }
  #in-practice > .dr-alt {
    background: var(--dr-band);
  }
  #in-practice .mk-section-header {
    max-width: none;
    margin: 0 0 2.25rem;
    padding: 0;
  }
  #in-practice .mk-section-header-title {
    font-size: clamp(1.875rem, 3.5vw, 2.5rem);
    line-height: 1.15;
  }
  #in-practice .mk-section-header-eyebrow {
    color: var(--primary);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  #in-practice .mk-section-header-desc {
    max-width: 44rem;
    font-size: 1.0625rem;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-hint a {
    color: inherit;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-underline-offset: 0.2em;
  }
  #in-practice :focus-visible {
    outline-width: 3px;
  }
  /* the closure notice */
  #in-practice .mk-announcement {
    background: var(--dr-note);
    color: var(--dr-note-ink);
  }
  #in-practice .mk-announcement-inner {
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  #in-practice .mk-announcement-tag {
    background: var(--dr-note-ink);
    color: var(--dr-note);
  }
  #in-practice .mk-announcement a {
    color: inherit;
  }
  /* the header bar */
  #in-practice .mk-header {
    border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  #in-practice .mk-header-inner {
    max-width: none;
    padding-inline: var(--dr-gutter);
  }
  #in-practice .mk-header-brand {
    gap: 0.65rem;
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #in-practice .mk-header-brand svg {
    width: 2rem;
    height: 2rem;
    color: var(--primary);
  }
  #in-practice .mk-header-name {
    color: var(--foreground);
    font: 700 1.125rem/1.15 var(--dr-heading);
  }
  #in-practice .mk-header-brand small {
    display: block;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  #in-practice .mk-header-nav .nav-menu-link {
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  #in-practice .mk-header-actions .select {
    width: auto;
  }
  #in-practice .mk-opening-hours-days dd span {
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  #in-practice .site-mode {
    flex: none;
    border: 1px solid var(--input);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #in-practice .site-mode:hover {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--accent-foreground);
  }
  #in-practice .mk-header-sheet-actions {
    display: grid;
    justify-items: start;
  }
  /* the hero and today's card */
  #in-practice .mk-hero {
    max-width: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4rem);
  }
  #in-practice .mk-hero-copy {
    max-width: 38rem;
  }
  #in-practice .mk-hero-badge {
    border-color: var(--border);
    background: var(--card);
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #in-practice .mk-hero-title {
    font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
    line-height: 1.08;
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  #in-practice[data-look='warm'] .mk-hero-title {
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #in-practice .mk-hero-desc {
    font-size: 1.1875rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #in-practice .dr-today {
    align-self: center;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  }
  #in-practice .dr-label {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-status {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 0.25rem 0.6rem;
    margin: 0 0 1.25rem;
    font-size: 1.125rem;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-status b {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.55rem;
    color: var(--dr-open);
    font: 700 1.75rem/1.2 var(--dr-heading);
  }
  #in-practice .dr-status b::before {
    content: '';
    width: 0.8rem;
    height: 0.8rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: currentColor;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.3rem color-mix(in oklch, currentColor 18%, transparent);
  }
  #in-practice .dr-status[data-open='no'] b {
    color: var(--dr-closed);
  }
  #in-practice .dr-status[data-open='no'] b::before {
    border-radius: 0.15rem;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-status span {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #in-practice .dr-rows {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.6rem;
    margin: 0;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-rows div {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0.15rem 1rem;
    padding-block-end: 0.6rem;
    border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  #in-practice .dr-rows div:last-child {
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-rows dt {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #in-practice .dr-rows dd {
    margin: 0;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    text-align: end;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-today .card-footer {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  /* services and the pinned flu note */
  #in-practice .dr-services-head {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 20rem);
    align-items: end;
    gap: 2rem 3rem;
    margin-block-end: 2.25rem;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-services-head .mk-section-header {
    margin: 0;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-note {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 20rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 1.5rem 1.4rem 1.25rem;
    background: var(--dr-note);
    color: var(--dr-note-ink);
    rotate: 2deg;
    box-shadow: 0 0.9rem 1.6rem -0.9rem oklch(0.2 0.03 230 / 0.45);
  }
  #in-practice .dr-note h3 {
    margin: 0 0 0.4rem;
    font-size: 1.125rem;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-note p {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-pin {
    position: absolute;
    top: -0.5rem;
    left: 50%;
    width: 1rem;
    height: 1rem;
    translate: -50% 0;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, oklch(1 0 0 / 0.55), transparent 45%), var(--dr-pin);
    box-shadow: 0 0.15rem 0.25rem oklch(0 0 0 / 0.35);
  }
  #in-practice .dr-tape {
    position: absolute;
    top: -0.65rem;
    left: 50%;
    width: 4.5rem;
    height: 1.3rem;
    translate: -50% 0;
    rotate: -3deg;
    background: var(--dr-pin);
  }
  #in-practice[data-look='contrast'] .dr-note {
    rotate: none;
    border: 3px solid var(--foreground);
    box-shadow: none;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-services {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 21rem), 1fr));
    gap: 1rem;
  }
  #in-practice .mk-service-item-desc {
    font-size: 1rem;
  }
  #in-practice[data-look='contrast']
    :is(.mk-service-item, .card, .mk-team-member[data-variant='horizontal'], .mk-opening-hours) {
    border-width: 2px;
  }
  /* the doctors and the team */
  #in-practice .dr-doctors {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 30rem), 1fr));
    gap: 1.25rem;
  }
  #in-practice .mk-team-member-bio {
    font-size: 1rem;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-team {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 15rem), 1fr));
    gap: 1rem 1.5rem;
    margin: 2rem 0 0;
    padding: 1.5rem 0 0;
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
    list-style: none;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-langs {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-langs li {
    display: grid;
    padding: 0.6rem 0.9rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background: var(--card);
    line-height: 1.3;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-langs b {
    font-size: 1rem;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-langs span {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-subhead {
    margin: 2.5rem 0 1rem;
    font-size: 1.25rem;
  }
  /* opening hours */
  #in-practice .dr-hours {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 21rem), 1fr));
    gap: 1.25rem;
    align-items: start;
  }
  #in-practice .mk-opening-hours {
    max-width: none;
  }
  #in-practice .mk-opening-hours-title {
    font-size: 1.25rem;
  }
  #in-practice .mk-opening-hours-status {
    color: var(--dr-open);
    font-size: 1rem;
  }
  #in-practice .mk-opening-hours-status[data-open='no'] {
    color: var(--dr-closed);
  }
  #in-practice .mk-opening-hours-days div {
    font-size: 1rem;
  }
  #in-practice .mk-opening-hours-exceptions {
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-card-list {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-card-list li {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-card-list svg {
    width: 1.25rem;
    height: 1.25rem;
    margin-block-start: 0.2rem;
    color: var(--primary);
  }
  #in-practice .dr-big {
    display: block;
    font: 700 1.5rem/1.2 var(--dr-heading);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-urgent {
    border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--destructive) 45%, var(--border));
  }
  #in-practice .dr-urgent .dr-big {
    color: var(--destructive);
  }
  /* the appointment request */
  #in-practice .mk-booking-form-option small {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-hint {
    display: none;
    margin: 0.75rem 0 0;
    padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
    border-inline-start: 4px solid var(--primary);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--accent-foreground);
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  #in-practice form:has([value='acute']:checked) .dr-hint[data-hint='acute'],
  #in-practice form:has([value='home']:checked) .dr-hint[data-hint='home'],
  #in-practice form:has([value='self']:checked) .dr-hint[data-hint='self'],
  #in-practice form:has([name='new']:checked) .dr-hint[data-hint='new'] {
    display: block;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-check {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.6rem;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-check .label {
    margin: 0;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-check .checkbox {
    margin-block-start: 0.2rem;
  }
  #in-practice .radio-group {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.6rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
  }
  #in-practice .mk-booking-form-summary .alert {
    text-align: start;
  }
  #in-practice .alert[data-variant='destructive'] .alert-title {
    font-size: 1rem;
  }
  #in-practice .alert[data-variant='destructive'] b {
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  /* prescriptions and new patients */
  #in-practice .dr-two {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem);
    align-items: start;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-form {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 1rem;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-field {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-field .label {
    margin: 0;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-wide {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-field .field-description {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-bring {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.9rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    counter-reset: bring;
    list-style: none;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-bring li {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 2.25rem minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 0.85rem;
    align-items: start;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-bring li::before {
    counter-increment: bring;
    content: counter(bring);
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 2.25rem;
    height: 2.25rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--primary);
    color: var(--primary-foreground);
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-bring b {
    display: block;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-bring span {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  /* finding the practice */
  #in-practice .dr-visit {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.4fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem);
    align-items: start;
  }
  #in-practice .mk-location-map-canvas {
    min-height: 0;
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 10;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-door {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 3 / 2;
    margin-block-end: 1.25rem;
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  }
  #in-practice .dr-river {
    fill: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.7 0.08 220) 35%, var(--muted));
  }
  #in-practice .dr-house {
    fill: var(--primary);
  }
  #in-practice .dr-map-label {
    fill: var(--muted-foreground);
    font:
      700 13px/1 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next',
      sans-serif;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-ways {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1.25rem;
    margin: 1.75rem 0 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-ways li {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 0.15rem 0.85rem;
  }
  #in-practice .dr-ways svg {
    grid-row: span 2;
    width: 1.5rem;
    height: 1.5rem;
    color: var(--primary);
  }
  #in-practice .dr-ways span {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  /* the footer */
  #in-practice > .mk-footer {
    padding-block: 0;
    background: var(--dr-band);
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  #in-practice .mk-footer-inner {
    max-width: none;
    padding: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 3.5rem) 0;
  }
  #in-practice .mk-footer-nav {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 13rem), 1fr));
    gap: 2rem;
  }
  #in-practice .mk-footer-heading {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  #in-practice .mk-footer-list {
    gap: 0.5rem;
    font-size: 1rem;
  }
  #in-practice .mk-footer-list address {
    font-style: normal;
  }
  #in-practice .mk-footer-list button {
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    background: none;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 0.2em;
  }
  #in-practice .mk-footer-list button:focus-visible {
    outline: 3px solid var(--ring);
    outline-offset: 2px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  }
  #in-practice .mk-footer-brand {
    margin: 0;
